messages:
Morgan L: Quick check — ran a latency sweep for model-x-3b (int8) across A100 pools in us-east / us-west / eu-west using edge routing policy 'alpha'. p50s are roughly the same but p95 in us-west is ~2.8x higher. Grafana + raw traces: https://grafana.redwood/app/d/latency-sweeps/edge-sweep :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Sanjay R: thx. can you share batch/seq/kernel/runtime? also which model variant (fp16 vs quant) exactly?

Morgan L: batch=1, seq=128, model=model-x-3b-quant-int8, runtime cuda11.8, cudnn 8.2. Kernel tried: opt-attn-v2 (default) and se-kernel-v3 in a follow-up. Both on A100. Command I ran: `rrun --model model-x-3b --quant int8 --batch 1 --seq 128 --region {region}`. Logs: https://logs.redwood/app/trace/xyz

Arla P: could be edge pop/proxy saturation — last night us-west pop showed elevated proxy CPU and connection queuing. Do you have per-hop latency/packet-drop?

Morgan L: pasted quick numbers inline to save clicks:
``
us-east  p50=48ms  p95=120ms  avg=60ms
us-west  p50=52ms  p95=340ms  avg=90ms
eu-west  p50=50ms  p95=140ms  avg=70ms
```

Kevin T: note - we started a small routing canary for edge-policy-alpha at ~02:08 UTC shifting 10% traffic through pop-w-lax. infra-bot shows canary active. That LAX pop had a brief spike in sysload at the exact window. Could be correlated.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary 'edge-policy-alpha' started 2025-06-12T02:08Z by kevin.t (id=cyn-1213) — tracking in #eng-infra.

Sanjay R: I'll run a kernel toggle in us-west only (opt-attn-v2 vs se-kernel-v3) and rerun the sweep. If kernel runtime interacts badly with the proxy TCP windowing it can inflate p95. Posting results in ~10m.

Arla P: I'll pull net metrics for pop-w-lax and pop-w-sfo and look for drops/conn resets and egress bandwidth cliffs. If proxy queuing is the culprit we should either bump proxy workers or move us-west traffic to SFO fallback.

Morgan L: appreciated. action plan: 1) Sanjay toggles kernels in us-west and re-run sweep. 2) Arla to produce per-pop net/queue heatmap. 3) Kevin to consider immediate small reroute to pop-w-sfo for 1hr if p95 stays bad. I'll capture updated charts after step 1/2. tagging @Sanjay R @Arla P @Kevin T :thumbsup:

Sanjay R: started kernel toggle: switching to se-kernel-v3 on us-west A100 pool now, retest in 6m.

Kevin T: if reroute is needed I'll open a short maintenance window and notify downstream teams.

Morgan L: great — once Sanjay posts numbers we'll decide. I suspect this is edge routing + proxy capacity, not model code, but let's prove it.

Sanjay R: results (quick):
``
us-west opt-attn-v2 -> p50=52ms p95=340ms
us-west se-kernel-v3  -> p50=50ms p95=150ms
```
looks like kernel path reduces tail by half.

Arla P: net metrics show 12% packet retransmits and a short 30s queue spike on LAX during the opt-attn-v2 runs. SFO pop did not show that.

Kevin T: ok — leaning to switch us-west to prefer pop-w-sfo fallback for the next 1h and then promote se-kernel-v3 globally if stable. I'll coordinate with infra.

Morgan L: excellent. next steps: (a) Kevin to rollback canary to fallback SFO for 1h, (b) Sanjay to run longer soak of se-kernel-v3 across us-west, (c) Arla to validate no other downstream regressions. I'll update the Grafana panel and close the loop. Thanks all.
